- Include title, axis labels, legend, and units as appropriate

2. Read `/app/benchmark/source_data.json` for the datasets to visualize.
3. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for dataset documentation and field descriptions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output the final chart to `/app/output/result.png`.
2. The chart must be a single self-contained PNG image file.

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — do not pause, ask questions, or wait for a reply. When encountering BLOCKING or "wait for user confirmation" instructions, make a professional judgment and proceed.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies a `style` field, use it to guide color schemes, layout, and design choices; otherwise, use your professional judgment.
3. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

def draw_arrow(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, color, dash=None, width=1):
    """Draw a line with arrowhead at target end."""
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    length = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    if length < 2:
        return
    udx, udy = dx/length, dy/length

    # Trim endpoints to avoid node overlap
    trim = 22
    ax0, ay0 = x0 + udx*trim, y0 + udy*trim
    ax1, ay1 = x1 - udx*trim, y1 - udy*trim

    if dash:
        # Draw dashed line
        seg_len, gap_len = dash
        d = 0
        while d < length - trim*2:
            sx = ax0 + udx*d
            sy = ay0 + udy*d
            ex = ax0 + udx*min(d+seg_len, length-trim*2)
            ey = ay0 + udy*min(d+seg_len, length-trim*2)
            draw.line([(sx,sy),(ex,ey)], fill=color, width=width)
            d += seg_len + gap_len
    else:
        draw.line([(ax0,ay0),(ax1,ay1)], fill=color, width=width)

    # Arrowhead
    arr_len = 8
    arr_w = 4
    ex, ey = ax1, ay1
    px, py = -udy, udx
    p1 = (ex - udx*arr_len + px*arr_w, ey - udy*arr_len + py*arr_w)
    p2 = (ex - udx*arr_len - px*arr_w, ey - udy*arr_len - py*arr_w)
    draw.polygon([(ex,ey), p1, p2], fill=color)

    bar_max = cols_w[5] - 24

leg_y += 30

legend_sections = [
    ("Tier Colors", [
        (C_ACCESS, "rect", "Access Layer — API entry points"),
        (C_BIZ,    "rect", "Business Layer — Core services"),

    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0

draw.line([(PAD, sep_y),(W-PAD, sep_y)], fill=BORDER, width=1)

# ---- STATS ROW ----
st_y = sep_y + 18
stat_items = [
    ("23","Total Nodes","12 svc + 6 infra + 5 obs"),
    ("44","Total Edges","37 sync · 7 async"),
    ("11","Mesh-Enabled","Istio sidecar services"),
    ("16","Proxied Edges","Service-mesh routed"),
    ("4","Shared Resources","Redis · Kafka · PG · Mongo"),
    ("7","Async Connections","Kafka + replication"),
]
sw = (W - PAD*2) // len(stat_items)
for i,(val,lbl,sub) in enumerate(stat_items):
    sx0 = PAD + i*sw
    rr(draw, sx0, st_y, sx0+sw-8, st_y+STATS_H-10, 8, fill=SURFACE, outline=BORDER, width=1)
    draw.text((sx0+14, st_y+10), lbl.upper(), font=F_STAT_L, fill=TEXT2)
    draw.text((sx0+14, st_y+24), val, font=F_STAT_V, fill=TEXT)
    draw.text((sx0+14, st_y+72), sub, font=F_STAT_L, fill=TEXT3)

# ---- HOTSPOT TABLE ----
tbl_y = st_y + STATS_H + 8
draw.text((PAD, tbl_y), "Dependency Complexity Hotspots", font=F_H2, fill=TEXT)
tbl_y += 28

app_nodes = sorted([n for n in nodes if n["tier"] in ("Access","Business","Data")],
                   key=lambda n: degree[n["id"]]["total"], reverse=True)
max_deg = max(degree[n["id"]]["total"] for n in app_nodes) or 1

col_ws = [210, 100, 80, 80, 100, 260]
col_xs = [PAD]
for cw in col_ws[:-1]:
    col_xs.append(col_xs[-1]+cw)
hdrs = ["Service","Tier","Inbound","Outbound","Total","Complexity"]

rr(draw, PAD, tbl_y, W-PAD, tbl_y+28, 0, fill=SURF2)
for ci,(hdr,cx2) in enumerate(zip(hdrs,col_xs)):
    draw.text((cx2+8,tbl_y+9), hdr.upper(), font=F_TBL_H, fill=TEXT2)
draw.line([(PAD,tbl_y+28),(W-PAD,tbl_y+28)], fill=BORDER, width=1)

for ri,n in enumerate(app_nodes[:n_table_rows]):
    ry = tbl_y + 28 + ri*TABLE_ROW_H
    if ri%2==0:
        draw.rectangle([PAD,ry,W-PAD,ry+TABLE_ROW_H], fill=tuple(int(c*1.06) for c in BG))
    d = degree[n["id"]]
    tc = {"Access":C_ACCESS,"Business":C_BIZ,"Data":C_DATA}[n["tier"]]
    is_hot = d["total"] >= 5
    draw.text((col_xs[0]+8,ry+9), n["label"], font=F_TBL, fill=C_HOT if is_hot else TEXT)
    # tier pill
    pw = 72
    px2 = col_xs[1]+8
    rr(draw, px2, ry+7, px2+pw, ry+TABLE_ROW_H-7, 10, fill=blend(tc,BG,0.18), outline=blend(tc,BG,0.4), width=1)
    draw.text((px2+8,ry+10), n["tier"], font=F_TBL_H, fill=tc)
    draw.text((col_xs[2]+8,ry+9), str(d["in"]),  font=F_TBL, fill=TEXT)
    draw.text((col_xs[3]+8,ry+9), str(d["out"]), font=F_TBL, fill=TEXT)
    draw.text((col_xs[4]+8,ry+9), str(d["total"]), font=F_TBL, fill=C_HOT if is_hot else TEXT)
    bar_max = col_ws[5]-24
    bar_fill = int(bar_max * d["total"] / max_deg)
    bc = C_HOT if is_hot else blend(C_ACCESS,BG,0.7)
    draw.rectangle([col_xs[5]+8,ry+13,col_xs[5]+8+bar_fill,ry+TABLE_ROW_H-13], fill=bc)
    draw.rectangle([col_xs[5]+8,ry+13,col_xs[5]+8+bar_max,ry+TABLE_ROW_H-13], fill=None, outline=BORDER)
    draw.line([(PAD,ry+TABLE_ROW_H),(W-PAD,ry+TABLE_ROW_H)], fill=BORDER, width=1)

# ---- LEGEND ----
leg_y = tbl_y + 28 + n_table_rows*TABLE_ROW_H + 22
draw.line([(PAD,leg_y),(W-PAD,leg_y)], fill=BORDER, width=1)
leg_y += 16
draw.text((PAD,leg_y), "Visual Encoding Legend", font=F_H2, fill=TEXT)
leg_y += 30

lsections = [
    ("TIER COLORS",[
        (C_ACCESS,"swatch","Access — API entry points"),
        (C_BIZ,   "swatch","Business — Core services"),
        (C_DATA,  "swatch","Data — Databases & queues"),
        (C_OBS,   "swatch","Observability — Monitoring"),
    ]),
    ("CONNECTION TYPES",[
        (C_SYNC,  "line_solid","Synchronous (gRPC, SQL, Redis, REST)"),
        (C_ASYNC, "line_dash", "Asynchronous (Kafka, replication)"),
        (C_PROXY, "line_solid","Service-mesh proxied (Istio sidecar)"),
        (blend(C_OBS,BG,0.5),"line_dot","Istio xDS control-plane"),
    ]),
    ("NODE INDICATORS",[
        (C_HOT,  "ring",  "High complexity (≥5 total connections)"),
        (C_MESH, "dot",   "Istio sidecar enabled (top-right dot)"),
        (C_DATA, "pill",  "Infrastructure component (pill shape)"),
        (C_OBS,  "dash",  "Observability component (dashed border)"),
    ]),
]

lcol_w = (W - PAD*2 - 24) // 3
for ci,(sec_title, items) in enumerate(lsections):
    lx = PAD + ci*(lcol_w+12)
    rr(draw, lx, leg_y, lx+lcol_w, leg_y+14+len(items)*28+12, 8, fill=SURFACE, outline=BORDER, width=1)
    draw.text((lx+12, leg_y+8), sec_title, font=F_LEG_H, fill=TEXT2)
    for ii,(color,shape,lbl) in enumerate(items):
        iy = leg_y + 28 + ii*28
        # indicator
        if shape=="swatch":
            rr(draw,lx+12,iy+2,lx+28,iy+18,3,fill=blend(color,BG,0.25),outline=blend(color,BG,0.7),width=1)
        elif shape=="line_solid":
            draw.line([(lx+12,iy+10),(lx+40,iy+10)],fill=color,width=2)
            draw.polygon([(lx+40,iy+10),(lx+34,iy+7),(lx+34,iy+13)],fill=color)
        elif shape=="line_dash":
            for dsx in range(lx+12, lx+40, 9):
                draw.line([(dsx,iy+10),(min(dsx+5,lx+40),iy+10)],fill=color,width=2)
            draw.polygon([(lx+40,iy+10),(lx+34,iy+7),(lx+34,iy+13)],fill=color)
        elif shape=="line_dot":
            for dsx in range(lx+12, lx+40, 7):
                if (dsx-lx-12)%7 < 3:
                    draw.line([(dsx,iy+10),(min(dsx+2,lx+40),iy+10)],fill=color,width=2)
        elif shape=="ring":
            draw.ellipse([lx+12,iy+2,lx+28,iy+18],outline=color,width=2)
        elif shape=="dot":
            draw.ellipse([lx+17,iy+5,lx+25,iy+15],fill=color)
        elif shape=="pill":
            rr(draw,lx+12,iy+4,lx+38,iy+16,6,fill=blend(color,BG,0.2),outline=blend(color,BG,0.6),width=1)
        elif shape=="dash":
            for dsx in range(lx+12,lx+40,8):
                draw.line([(dsx,iy+2),(min(dsx+4,lx+40),iy+2)],fill=color,width=1)
                draw.line([(dsx,iy+18),(min(dsx+4,lx+40),iy+18)],fill=color,width=1)
            draw.line([(lx+12,iy+2),(lx+12,iy+18)],fill=color,width=1)
            draw.line([(lx+40,iy+2),(lx+40,iy+18)],fill=color,width=1)
        draw.text((lx+46,iy+3),lbl,font=F_LEG,fill=TEXT2)

img.save("/app/output/result.png","PNG")
sz = os.path.getsize("/app/output/result.png")
print(f"Saved {img.size}, {sz:,} bytes")
PYEOF
